parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body??$json;const headers=$json.headers??{};const decision=body.decision||'approved';const reviewerId=body.reviewer_id||'andy';const reviewerType=body.reviewer_type||'';const normalized={...body,decision,reviewer_id:reviewerId,reviewer_type:reviewerType};const rawBody=JSON.stringify(normalized).replace(/'/g,"''");return [{json:{...normalized,job_id:body.job_id||$json.job_id||'',agent_secret:headers['x-agent-secret']||headers['X-Agent-Secret']||'',body_sql:rawBody,allowed_decision:['approved','rejected','revision_requested'].includes(decision),is_human:reviewerType==='human'}}];

parameters.query: =WITH payload AS (SELECT '{{$json.body_sql}}'::jsonb AS body), valid AS (SELECT (body->>'decision') IN ('approved','rejected','revision_requested') AS valid_decision, COALESCE(body->>'reviewer_type','')='human' AS is_human FROM payload), approval_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_approvals (job_id,approval_stage,decision,reviewer_id,reviewer_notes) SELECT NULLIF(body->>'job_id','')::uuid,'final_delivery',body->>'decision',COALESCE(NULLIF(body->>'reviewer_id',''),'andy'),NULLIF(body->>'reviewer_notes','') FROM payload,valid WHERE valid_decision AND is_human RETURNING job_id,decision), event_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata) SELECT job_id,'final_delivery_approval_recorded','Final delivery approval recorded',jsonb_build_object('decision',decision,'reviewer_type','human') FROM approval_insert) SELECT (SELECT valid_decision FROM valid) AS valid_decision,(SELECT is_human FROM valid) AS is_human,(SELECT job_id::text FROM approval_insert) AS job_id,(SELECT decision FROM approval_insert) AS decision;
